mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, reducing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 750 thousand units and retail sales below 405,000 million dollars indicate a contraction in consumer demand, compressing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST < 750 and RSAFS < 405000, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually indicates supply chain constraints and manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls above 133 million support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 133 million, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 750 thousand units signal reduced consumer confidence in the housing sector, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 750, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation above 2.5% annually with federal funds rate below 1.0% creates a policy dilemma that increases market uncertainty and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2.0% annually in a late-cycle expansion regime supports strong corporate earnings and investor optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 annualized growth rate exceeds 2.0%, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations.
